Use reasoning (chain of thought) to plan a natural English–Mandarin dialogue about resolving a deployment bug,

Li: Great, 谢谢你！We really need to fix this before the deadline.
Sarah: 没问题，我会尽快调试并部署修复程序。I'll keep you updated on my progress.

Sarah: 不客气，我们是一个团队。We'll get this bug sorted out in no time.
